name: Small Bowl with Flaring Lip and Partridge-Feather Mottles
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；late 11th-first half 12th century；Northern black ware of Cizhou type: off-white stoneware with dark brown glaze, the interior with russet markings in iron oxide, the exterior with russet skin. Probably from the Cizhou kilns at Guantai, Cixian, Hebei province.
